items.source_en:
RST-9090-A44

Something... happened today. Words can't even describe the horrors that I've witnessed. Dreshdae... is mostly gone. Where our proud city once stood there now sits a huge crater.... yet somehow the Scaled Citadel was spared. From what I hear, thousands are missing and presumed dead. I don't understand what has happened. We're very isolated out here under the refinery, only recieving communications from the Keep on a weekly basis. If you are recieving this message, I urge you to contact us immediately. Otherwise, we will remain here as ordered and continue SIEP.

All Must Serve
items.legacy_ko:
RST-9090-A44

모두가 섬겨야 한다
